notes: ROS 1 (indigo), actionlib 1.11.5. All packet elements are Python API symbols (dot-qualified, snake_case), matched to the rospy implementation in src/actionlib/simple_action_client.py rather than the C++ template actionlib::SimpleActionClient (include/actionlib/client/simple_action_client.h, which uses camelCase waitForServer/sendGoal/getResult/getState/cancelGoal). API elements carry no message type, frame, units, QoS, rate or definition hash, so those fields are null (QoS is null for ROS 1 in any case); definition_id is null because an API symbol has no .msg/.srv/.action definition. The action namespace and ActionSpec type are supplied at run time by the caller of SimpleActionClient(ns, ActionSpec) (line 53), so no topic names are fixed by this API. Declaration lines are copied verbatim with leading indentation stripped. The code also uses actionlib_msgs GoalStatus constants (e.g. GoalStatus.LOST, line 169) and the package's own ActionClient/CommState; none of these are packet elements, so references is left empty. No exclusive resources are claimed. Additional public methods not in the packet (send_goal_and_wait, wait_for_result, get_goal_status_text, cancel_all_goals, cancel_goals_at_and_before_time, stop_tracking_goal) are also declared.
